build_faster_rcnn_resnest50_config: build a faster-rcnn model config using ResNeSt-50 backbone with SyncBN and multi-scale range training on COCO
create_train_pipeline_ms_range: create a training pipeline with multi-scale random resize, random flip, and packed detection inputs for COCO
configure_syncbn_backbone_head: configure a ResNeSt-50 backbone with SyncBN normalization and Shared4Conv1FCBBoxHead for faster-rcnn detection
setup_multi_scale_training: setup multi-scale range training with scales [(1333, 640), (1333, 800)] and keep_ratio for object detection
load_pretrained_resnest50: load a pretrained ResNeSt-50 checkpoint from open-mmlab registry for faster-rcnn detection head initialization
